summary: Preinstall script exfiltrates installer identity to Burp Collaborator endpoint
details: preinstall.js runs automatically on `npm install` and reads the installer's OS username (USER/USERNAME env) and `os.hostname()`, then transmits those values plus the package name to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at 4otph6fase1x2won0hrfzul2wt2qqge5.oastify.com via both a DNS lookup and an HTTPS GET to `/depconf/<pkg>/<user>/<hostname>`. The package name uses the `@wbnr` scope, consistent with a dependency-confusion payload targeting an internal namespace; whether framed as a proof-of-concept or not, installer identity leaves the machine to an attacker-controlled callback host on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
